consent.title: Cookies
consent.body: We use cookies to measure how the site is used and to improve the service. You choose whether we may.
consent.replay: If you accept, we may record how the configure, design and ordering pages are used — with all text and everything you type masked — to find what is hard to use.

guarantee.title: Our guarantee
guarantee.intro: If what you receive has a problem, this is what getpack does, by the kind of problem and how serious it is
guarantee.emptyTitle: The guarantee is not published yet
guarantee.emptyBody: We are preparing it. If an order has a problem, report a claim from its page
guarantee.days: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of delivery
guarantee.businessDays: {count, plural, one {# business day} other {# business days}}
guarantee.clock: While we wait for more information from you, the decision clock stops
guarantee.severityHint: The team rates the severity from the evidence you send
guarantee.evidenceBody: When you report a claim, it tells you the evidence each kind of problem needs, such as photos
guarantee.tolerances: Each order's tolerances (short or over quantity, size variation) are on its quotation and order page

network.title: getpack's production standard
network.intro: Every job ordered through getpack meets the same production standard, from the file check to the final check before dispatch, and getpack is the seller responsible to you throughout.

files.title: File and spec check
files.body: Our team checks the file, size, material and spec before production starts. If something needs fixing, we tell you before production starts.

during.title: Checks during production
during.body: The job is checked during production against the proof and spec you approved.

final.title: Check before dispatch
final.body: Size, colour and quantity are checked against the criteria below before the job is packed and dispatched.

secrecy.title: Confidentiality
secrecy.body: Your files and details are used only to make your job. They are not published or used for any other job.

size.label: Size
size.note: Against the size stated in your order

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.note: Any shortfall is refunded as credit

proof.title: Proof to approve
proof.body: Review and approve the proof before production starts

status.title: Status
status.body: Follow your order at every step

inspection.title: Inspection results
inspection.body: See the quality inspection results for your job

guarantee.title: Job guarantee
guarantee.body: Raise a claim under the guarantee terms

responsible.question: Who is responsible for my job?
responsible.answer: getpack is the seller and is responsible for your job from order to delivery. If anything goes wrong, you deal with us only.

files.question: Are my files safe?
files.answer: Your files and details are used only to make your job. They are not published or used for any other job.

mismatch.question: What if the job does not meet the standard?
mismatch.answer: Raise a claim under the guarantee terms. We review it and act as set out on the guarantee page.

range.question: What can I order?
range.answer: See everything on the products page. Some items show an instant price; others you request a quotation for.
